# Fused Distribution

> Fused Distribution is run by Nick Hughes in Vancouver, WA. The main business is Fused Technology Solutions: custom websites for small businesses that also write their own blog posts and make their own narrated videos, plus AI setup and training. It serves Vancouver, WA, Portland, OR and the surrounding metro area, and works remote for clients anywhere. It also runs Fused Reserve (silver subscriptions), coins and collectibles, Fused Photos (free use photography), Fused Education (books and coaching) and the Coin History Talk media brand.

## About

One person owns every part of the work: the build, the hosting, the content and the follow up. There is no agency layer, broker or middleman. The owner is Nick Hughes.

The flagship is Fused Technology Solutions. A first draft of the client's site is ready in 24 to 48 hours, and the client sees the whole site built before paying anything. The client owns the website. If they cancel, they keep the raw files and can move to any other host or provider.

## Fused Technology Solutions (websites, video and AI)

- Custom websites for small businesses, built before payment
- First draft in 24 to 48 hours
- Pricing: Foundation $99/mo ($1,000/yr), Standard $499/mo ($4,990/yr), Expansion from $999/mo (from $9,990/yr, priced to scope)
- Foundation: custom site, Cloudflare hosting, SSL, contact form, one content update per month
- Standard: 8 fact checked blog posts and 8 video reels per month, narrated in the client's own cloned voice and posted to 3 social channels the client picks; local SEO; managed newsletter; review requests; standard workflow automation; monthly report; a monthly 1 hour 1:1 session
- Expansion: everything in Standard plus more social channels (up to all 11), plus Google Business Profile setup and management, custom workflows, custom AI agents, an AI website chat assistant, 1:1 project management, staff training with written guides, missed call text back, quarterly shoots, and higher content volume
- Supported social channels: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Pinterest, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, and Google Business Profile (Expansion). Facebook Pages, not personal profiles.
- Hosted by Fused, or self hosted on the client's own machine ($499 one time setup on monthly Standard, free with annual, included in Expansion subject to scope)
- No long contracts on monthly plans
- Service area: Vancouver, WA, Portland, OR and surrounding metros; remote work always available
- URL: https://fuseddistribution.com/pricing/

## What clients say

- Tanner Bemis, Outpost, Vancouver, WA: Nick taught him the skills and tools to use AI, which took repetitive tasks off his plate and let him take on more projects.
- Alex Bredesen, Data Dog, Vancouver, WA: Nick got his social media onto a regular daily rhythm with a package customized to his business, and was easier and faster to reach than previous providers.
- Ken Vilkin, Coins and Auctions Since 1994: Nick trained his social media team, ran the project with clear status updates, and built the Coin History Talk website.

## Fused Reserve (silver subscriptions)
- Monthly silver bullion subscription
- Bullion at a low premium over spot, with curated inventory
- Direct sourcing relationships, no broker markup
- Ship physical silver or hold it in allocated storage
- Tiers for new buyers and experienced stackers
- URL: https://fuseddistribution.com/reserve/

## Coins and collectibles
- Coins, related collectibles and rare antiquities, sourced through the same network as Fused Reserve

## Fused Education (books, coaching, training)
- Book: "The Richest Dev In The Valley" (coming soon), a modern parable on wealth, Bitcoin, and the old rules that still apply
- 1:1 coaching sessions, including AI strategy and workflow coaching
- Group coaching (quarterly on Standard and Expansion)
- URL: https://fuseddistribution.com/education/

## How a website gets built

1. Kickoff conversation about the business, goals and audience
2. Custom build with no payment; the first draft is ready in 24 to 48 hours and previewed live
3. The client picks a plan, the site goes live on their domain, and ongoing management begins

## Who Fused serves

Local service businesses: restaurants, repair shops, contractors, salons, auction houses and other small businesses. Not a fit for large shopping cart stores right now.
